text: The inspected memory/disk replay branches retain three PR_ASSERT calls with only condition expressions: mutually exclusive buffers, zero memory-buffer size/offset, and a present file buffer. None has an explicit expected-behavior message argument. This source observation is limited to the branches touched by the cleanup rewrite. The current user assertion-message requirement is deliberate guidance; historical use of this macro does not change that requirement, and this finding does not impose a global macro migration or claim a runtime failure.
title: Three condition-only assertions remain in the related MIME replay branches
